query: vpn keeps dropping every few minutes
passage: The corporate VPN client reconnects automatically when the tunnel drops. If disconnects happen more than once an hour, switch from the UDP transport to TCP in the client's settings and restart the app. Persistent drops on home Wi-Fi are often caused by router-level packet filtering, so try a different network before opening a ticket.

query: how do i get on the vpn from home
passage: Remote access starts with the corporate VPN client, which is preinstalled on all managed laptops. Sign in with your SSO credentials and complete the MFA prompt. First-time users should run the client once while on the office network so it can fetch the right configuration profile.

query: split tunnel or full tunnel, which one are we using
passage: The default configuration is full tunnel: all traffic goes through the corporate VPN while it is connected. Split tunnel profiles exist for engineering teams that need direct access to vendor endpoints. Ask in the IT help channel for the profile name and it will be pushed to your device.

query: can i use the vpn on my personal laptop
passage: The VPN client may be installed on one personal machine per employee for light use such as checking dashboards. Personal devices must run a supported OS version and have disk encryption enabled before the client will connect. Heavy work should stay on your managed laptop.

query: vpn profile for the contractors
passage: Contractors receive a restricted VPN profile that reaches only the systems named in their statement of work. The profile expires after 90 days and is renewed by their internal sponsor. Contractors cannot reach the general file shares or the admin tools.

query: why is the vpn so slow on video calls
passage: Video calls running through the full tunnel can lose quality on long-distance routes. The media endpoints are excluded from the tunnel on managed devices, so calls should connect directly. If you still hear stutter, set the client region to the one closest to you and restart it.

query: vpn stuck on authenticating
passage: When the client hangs at the authenticating step, check that the system clock is set to automatic, then sign out of the client and back in. An expired MFA enrollment shows the same symptom. Re-enroll from the account portal if the clock is not the cause.

query: do i need the vpn for the staging environment
passage: Staging is reachable over the VPN only. Connect, then use the staging dashboard URL from the internal wiki. Production access still requires a separate approval, and the VPN alone does not grant it.

query: new phone, how do i move my vpn mfa
passage: When you replace your phone, enroll the new device in MFA from the account portal before deleting the old app. The VPN client picks up the new enrollment on the next sign-in. If you already wiped the old device, ask IT to send a fresh enrollment link.

query: is the vpn supported on linux
passage: Linux is supported through the command-line client in the internal package repository. The graphical client is not shipped for Linux. Connect with vpnctl up, and the configuration file lives in the .config folder of your home directory.

query: password expired again, ugh
passage: Passwords expire every 180 days and a reminder email arrives two weeks ahead. Change yours from the account portal; the new password cannot match the last five. If it already expired, the change must be done from the office network or over the VPN.

query: sso login loop on the crm
passage: A sign-in loop in the CRM usually means the SSO session cookie was blocked. Allow third-party cookies for the SSO domain, or open the CRM in a normal window instead of a private one. Clearing cookies for just the SSO domain fixes it without signing you out everywhere.

query: how to reset yubikey pairing
passage: A YubiKey that stopped being recognized can be re-paired from the account portal under security keys. Remove the old entry, plug the key into a USB port, and tap it when the browser prompts. Two keys are recommended so a lost one does not lock you out.

query: mfa push not arriving on my android
passage: Missing MFA pushes are usually the notification permission on the phone, not the service. Open the authenticator app, force a token refresh, and check that battery optimization is not stopping it in the background. You can always type the six-digit code instead of approving the push.

query: where to put a shared team password
passage: Team credentials belong in the company password manager, in the team vault, never in a spreadsheet or a wiki page. Vault entries support notes, attachments and per-member access. Request a new vault through the account portal if your team does not have one.

query: locked out after too many login tries
passage: Five failed sign-ins lock an account for 15 minutes as an anti-brute-force measure. The lock clears itself; there is nothing to reset. If you still cannot sign in after the lock clears, use the self-service recovery flow before contacting IT.

query: does the password manager work in the browser
passage: The company password manager has browser extensions for the four common browsers. Sign in to the extension with SSO; autofill then works on all sites except ones flagged as sensitive, where you copy from the app instead. Extension updates ship through the normal browser store.

query: guest sso for external people
passage: External collaborators get scoped SSO accounts that expire with the project. They sign in with their own company email through a guest flow and see only the shared drives named in the invitation. Internal sponsors are responsible for removing access when the work ends.

query: where do i get recovery codes for mfa
passage: One-time recovery codes are generated in the account portal under MFA settings, right after enrollment. Each code works once, and there are ten. Store them in the password manager, not in a note on the phone, because the phone is the thing you might lose.

query: is sign in with google ok for work accounts
passage: Work accounts sign in only through the company SSO page. Sign-in buttons from big personal providers will not match your work identity and create a personal account nobody can administer. Always use the sign-in-with-SSO link, which the SSO portal lists per vendor.

query: need a bigger monitor for my desk
passage: Monitors up to 34 inches ship from the hardware catalogue with next-day delivery to the office. Choose the 27-inch model unless your work involves large spreadsheets or design. Home delivery is available once per employee per year.

query: my laptop is 4 years old, can i get a new one
passage: Laptops are refreshed on a four-year cycle and the replacement request opens automatically 60 days before your refresh date. Early replacement needs manager approval and a reason such as hardware failure or a new role. Check your refresh date in the asset portal.

query: keyboard broke, where do i get a replacement
passage: Broken peripherals are replaced without approval through the hardware catalogue; keyboards, mice and headsets all count. Submit the request and keep the broken item, IT sends a return label within a week. Next-day delivery applies to office addresses.

query: order a docking station for the home desk
passage: Docking stations come in two models: USB-C for current laptops and a legacy dock for the few remaining older machines. The catalogue picks the right one based on your assigned asset. One dock per person, home delivery included.

query: phone allowance, what can i claim

query: laptop repair, where do i drop it off
passage: Hardware repairs go through the office front desk: hand in the laptop in a padded sleeve with a short note about the fault. Repairs take three to five working days, and a loaner laptop is available on request. Data is not backed up for you, so sync before handing it in.

query: second laptop for the home office, possible?
passage: A second computer is approved only for roles that legally require device separation, such as some contractor work. Request it through the asset portal with a one-line justification. It is provisioned with the same image and counts as a separate asset.

query: headset with a mic for calls, what is recommended
passage: The catalogue lists two approved headsets: a wired USB-C model and a Bluetooth one with a dongle. Both are tested with the meeting software and ship with spare ear pads. Choose Bluetooth only if you take calls away from the desk.

query: returning equipment when leaving the company
passage: All company hardware is returned on or before the last working day; the offboarding checklist lists your items. IT sends a prepaid return box to your home if you work remotely. Unreturned items are charged against the final payslip where local law allows.

query: mouse and keyboard for left-handed people
passage: Left-handed input devices are stocked in the office supply room and in the hardware catalogue. The catalogue models have swappable button mappings configured by a small utility that IT preinstalls. Ask the office manager for the supply-room code.

query: expense report deadline each month

query: client dinner limit per head
passage: Client meals are reimbursable up to 60 per external guest, with one guest list required. Alcohol is covered up to a third of the total. Attach the itemised receipt, not the card slip, and name every attendee in the notes field.

query: is the taxi to the airport reimbursable
passage: Taxis and rideshares to airports are covered for business trips, including the early-morning and late-night ones. query: lost a receipt, what do i do
passage: A missing receipt is replaced by a signed declaration in the expense tool, which your manager countersigns. The declaration flow is capped at five percent of your monthly total. Card statements are not accepted as receipts.

query: hotel cap for the berlin offsite
passage: Offsite accommodation is booked by the travel team within a set cap per city; Berlin sits at 140 per night. Personal upgrades to better rooms are paid privately. If you extend a stay for leisure, the extra nights and the room-rate difference are yours.

query: mileage rate for using my own car

query: flights economy only or is premium ok
passage: Flights under six hours are economy; long-haul flights over six hours can be booked in premium economy. Business class requires documented medical reasons and HR sign-off. Book through the travel tool so the fare lands in the right cost centre.

query: when do approved expenses get paid

query: team lunch for a project milestone, can i claim

query: expense tool says policy violation but i followed the policy

query: lost my badge, what now

query: door code for the lab floor

query: guest coming in, how to register

query: is the office open on weekends

query: how does the bike parking in the basement work
passage: The basement bike room holds 80 bikes and opens with your badge, so registration is automatic. The room has charge points for e-bikes and a small repair stand with basic tools. Broken locks are replaced by facilities within a day.

query: badge stopped working at the turnstile

query: after hours access, who can let me in
passage: Nobody lets you in: outside staffed hours the doors only open with your own badge, and tailgating counts as a security incident. If your badge does not work after hours, the access portal shows your entitlements. Weekend and evening access needs no special permission, just a valid badge.

query: new hire badge, when is it ready

query: can family visit the office for lunch

query: how to get a parking spot at the office

query: book a room for a client call

query: quiet rooms for focused work

query: calendar showing wrong working hours

query: external guest invite to the standup, how

query: cancel a meeting series without nuking single edits

query: how many vacation days per year

query: book time off, how far in advance

query: sick day, do i need a doctor note

query: public holidays in the other country office
passage: Each office follows its own public-holiday calendar, published on the intranet in December for the next year. Your home office calendar applies to you, even if your team sits elsewhere. Days that fall on a weekend are not moved.

query: parental leave, how does it start
passage: Parental leave starts with a conversation with People Ops at least eight weeks before the expected date. The portal has the paperwork, and statutory rules of your country override anything in the handbook. Returning parents can phase back in at 60 to 80 percent for up to three months.

query: does a sabbatical policy exist

query: working from another country for a month

query: do vacation days expire at the end of the year

query: is unpaid leave possible

query: holiday shutdown between christmas and new year
passage: The office closes between Christmas and New Year; those days are company holidays and do not touch your vacation balance. Support rosters cover a skeleton crew, and slots are voluntary with a day off in return. The intranet lists the exact dates each year.

query: where to download the payslip
passage: Payslips are in the payroll portal under Documents on the second working day of the month. They stay available for the whole employment plus ten years. A contact form in the portal reaches payroll for corrections.

query: change bank account for salary

query: health insurance plan comparison

query: pension contribution match, how much
passage: The company matches pension contributions up to 4 percent of base salary into the group scheme. The match vests after two years. You can change your contribution rate once a quarter in the payroll portal.

query: when does the year end tax statement arrive

query: salary review cycle timing

query: commuting subsidy for the transit pass
passage: The transit subsidy covers 50 percent of a monthly public-transport pass, applied as a taxable benefit. Upload the pass receipt in the benefits portal once and it renews until you cancel. Bike schemes are separate and run through the leasing partner.

query: bonus payout date this year

query: does the company top up parental pay
passage: Statutory parental pay is topped up by the company to 100 percent of base salary for six months, per the parental policy. The top-up applies while the parental-leave agreement is active. Part-time phases scale the top-up with the contracted hours.

query: how is overtime tracked and paid
passage: Overtime is logged in the time tool and either paid out or converted to time off, chosen per entry. Non-exempt roles are paid monthly with the salary; exempt roles take time off instead. Managers see the running balance in their team report.

query: got a weird email asking about invoices

query: where is the report phishing button in the mail client
passage: The phish button sits in the ribbon of the mail client under the shield icon. On mobile it is in the three-dot menu of an open email. Reporting moves the mail to the security team and deletes it from your inbox in one step.

query: laptop lost or stolen abroad
passage: Report a lost device immediately in the security portal or by phone to the number on the badge; the device is wiped on next connection. Local police reports are needed for insurance within 48 hours. The travel insurance card in the wallet app has the emergency line.

query: usb stick found in the car park

query: is a password pasted in a ticket bad
passage: Passwords in tickets, chat or screenshots are a reportable incident even when accidental. The security team rotates the credential and scrubs the ticket. Nothing happens to you; hiding it is what causes harm.

query: security training deadline

query: safe to install that browser extension?

query: someone called claiming to be from IT

query: data breach, what do i do first

query: wire transfer request from a ceo email

query: need a tool installed that is not in the catalogue

query: adobe license for the design team

query: office license on a second machine

query: new tool procurement, how to get it approved
passage: New vendors go through the procurement flow: a short form in the license portal, then security and legal review. Budget approval sits with your department head. The average review takes two weeks; rush reviews cost a rush fee.

query: license expired warning on startup

query: are open source tools ok to use

query: chat tool notification settings for focus time

query: project management tool for a new team

query: video editing software for the social team

query: is beta software allowed on the work laptop
